name: antigravity-reviewers
description: Independent second-opinion reviews from Google's Antigravity CLI (agy), using Gemini or any model agy offers (Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT-OSS). Review code, security, architecture, API/UX design and tests, or documents such as resumes, plans, ideas, reports and presentations together with their context, then triage the feedback and decide together what to change.
